    Activities & Engagement

    My activities outside research reflect the qualities I bring to collaborative work: curiosity, adaptability, endurance and a desire to contribute usefully to the people around me.

    Exploration & endurance

    Travel and outdoor activities

    Solo travel, cycling and bicycle touring, hiking and climbing. These experiences develop autonomy, preparation and the ability to adapt to unfamiliar environments.

    Community engagement

    Giving time and supporting others

    Regular blood donor. I have also participated in outreach rounds and distributions with Secours populaire, and supported student life as a CROUS student representative by facilitating communication between residents and the administration.

    Continuous learning

    Science and broad curiosity

    I enjoy exploring scientific and technical subjects beyond my immediate research area, learning new tools and discussing ideas with people from different disciplines and backgrounds.
